# Grand Konark Hotel Website - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
Ultra-premium hotel website for HOTEL GRAND KONARK ELLORA with luxury aesthetic, fully responsive design, and WhatsApp booking integration.

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 14 (App Router)
- React 18
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion & GSAP
- Swiper.js
- LightGallery
- React Icons
- Next Image Optimization

## Design System
- **Colors**: Dark Charcoal (#1a1a1a), Ivory (#f5f1e8), Royal Gold (#d4af37)
- **Typography**: Playfair Display (headings), Cormorant Garamond (accents), Poppins (body)
- **UI Pattern**: Glassmorphism with subtle golden gradients
- **Animations**: Smooth transitions using Framer Motion and GSAP

## Key Features to Implement
1. Cinematic hero section with background image/video
2. Room showcase with pricing from JSON
3. Dynamic attraction pages with image galleries
4. Masonry gallery with lightbox
5. Guest testimonials carousel
6. Booking modal with WhatsApp integration
7. Floating action buttons (WhatsApp, Call, Book)
8. SEO optimization (sitemap, robots.txt, structured data)
9. Premium loading animation
10. Fully responsive across all devices
